svg.title: A countermodel of p(a) ⊢ p(f(a)), r
svg.desc: A finite structure, drawn as one world. World 0, the model's world, has the elements 0 and 1, where a = 0, f(0) = 1, f(1) = 0, and forces p(0). The structure makes every formula left of ⊢ true and every formula right of it false, so p(a) ⊢ p(f(a)), r is not valid in classical logic.
